title: Resolve the cross-domain synthesis gap in the wiki gateway
do_not_reopen: The data-collectives research project is complete (foundation + Stage 2, both grounded into the wiki). This continuation is only about the tool limitation it exposed.

problem.summary: No way to produce a grounded synthesis page that draws a balanced grounding context from, and is tagged to, more than one domain.
verified_2026_06_11: wiki answer --domain X hard-excludes other domains; Stage 2 auto-synthesis refused because condo sources were out of the named domain.

Omitting --domain retrieves globally but a single ranked k-window collapses toward the lexically-dominant domain: cross-domain query returned 2/2 data-collectives sections; condo-heavy query did reach condo-capital-infra; balanced query k=12 returned 3/3 data-collectives.
wiki answer writes single-valued domain frontmatter at src/gateway/ops/answer.py:222 ('domains': [domain] if domain else []).
problem.current_workaround: Manual scaffold-then-replace: wiki answer --file (shell) -> wiki edit --section (hand-authored, hand-cited body) -> wiki finalize, then patch domains:/sources_count by direct Edit. Works but undiscoverable and error-prone.

solution_shapes: Multi-value --domains a,b,c on wiki retrieve/answer with per-domain quota merge (retrieve ~k/N per domain, merge + re-rank). Smallest change; fixes balance.
Dedicated wiki synthesize --domains a,b op: per-domain retrieval + merge + one grounded call + multi-domain frontmatter + finalize.
Quota-merge inside the global no-domain path (changes default ranking; gated by golden set).
Independently: make domains: frontmatter list-valued from the authoring op (fixes the tagging point regardless of retrieval fix).
recommended_bias: Multi-value --domains + per-domain-quota merge (fixes retrieval balance) plus list-valued domains: frontmatter (fixes tagging). Run wiki eval-retrieval --compare before/after any ranking change.
read_first: wiki retrieve op + ranking core (FTS5/BM25 + graph authority)
constraints: Gateway-only writes to wiki/ and raw/; frontmatter via direct Edit only (no gateway op).
TDD: RED test first for quota-merge / multi-domain behavior.
Golden-set eval before/after ranking changes: wiki eval-retrieval --compare; do not regress recall@5 0.889 / recall@10 0.926 / MRR 0.722.
Anthropic spend cap is live; retrieval/merge work is LLM-free, keep any end-to-end answer smoke test to one small call.
Staging discipline: never git add -u or git add wiki/; pre-existing condo backlog in the working tree. Stage src/, tests/, docs, WIKI.md, log.md explicitly.
first_atomic_step: Brainstorm the design, then write a RED test asserting a multi-domain retrieve over a cross-domain query returns sections from each named domain (quota-balanced), not just the dominant one; confirm it fails against current behavior before implementing.
